cases.meaning: Recommendation to ask provider to bill plan first is separate from member reimbursement.
Already-paid covered-service reimbursement retains plan-share scope and paid antecedent.
Unpaid bill can be sent to plan for payment request; prior member payment is not required.
EOC34 paid-over-share and full-cost bill request alternatives remain separate from automatic reimbursement.
Generic in-most-cases OON rule retains each emergency/urgent/plan-referral/network-referral alternative.
Full-cost consequence is bound to the uncovered branch after listed exceptions fail, without universal POS applicability.
Medicare payment of its share for an approved study is separate from plan notice and payment-difference statement.
EOC35 qualified-trial notice predicate is present on the plan cost-sharing/payment statement; no invented advance deadline.
Documentation of paid cost sharing qualifies reimbursement, not participation permission.
Nonapproved-study all-cost liability stays a separate branch.
Examples remain otherwise-covered routine study items, not unrestricted trial costs.
Encouraged advance participation notice and no permission gate remain untouched and distinct from payment notice.
Only three designated rules may change; all other rules, parents and seven substantive holds remain exact.
Same original denominator/required states; new effects and branches are not new obligations or accepted facts.
Recovered intro-clause reference adds provenance only; r4 integration is separate and unknown/insufficient outcome remains.

prior_exposure: Root authored the sealed r1 findings and read original source pixels; producer status disclosed only correction scope/check counts. Not a blind source study.
